notes.title: Space Ops VR is now available to all FARHOME owners!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045110/Space_Ops_VR/
Hello friends!

First of all, we would like to apologize for such a delayed response from our team. Unfortunately, some legal aspects did not allow us to give any comments regarding FARHOME game. We have read all comments and we understand your feelings.

It is, therefore, a great pleasure for us to share with you the following news. 

1.We have solved all legal issues related to FARHOME game.

2. As you probably have noticed, some assets were already used in Space Ops VR. Now we can bring most of FARHOME content to Space Ops VR. It means that you will see the single-player content in Space Ops VR! We are now porting FARHOME missions and soon we will start adding the brand new ones.

3. Space Ops VR will combine two projects. There won't be any further development of FARHOME game and we are sorry about it but we have great news for all who own FARHOME. 

4. All of you who already bought FARHOME will get a copy of Space Ops VR for free. 
Please check your game library.

Prepare for the next battle!

notes.title: BLOG #7 Expedition and military squad
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/742a54b208cc04bf25129d43afd93392c75e7c97.jpg[/img]

Hi guys! 

It’s time to tell you more about the expedition that braves the world of WASP-21.

The expedition started from Earth in 2301 and reached its target, the Wasp-21 “Ariadne” system, in two years.

The expedition personnel consists of 4200 members. The fleet has 3 main expeditionary cruisers (each carries a few transports and 3 combat spacecraft units), 3 corvettes, and the commander’s ship.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/5549da384afb773ca1422a0bbf9b6b52236ca769.jpg[/img]

[u]Fleet Commander:[/u] Ingvar Loddon, Cavalier of the Black and Red Star.
[u]Chief Engineer responsible for base deployment:[/u] Max Hoe.
[u]Chief of Scientific Department and SLF Department:[/u] Eve Sil Eddin, plenipotentiary representative of the Association.
[u]Military Special Squad Commander:[/u] Lodge Moore.

[b]Goal:[/b] to deploy the base and the extraction systems, to construct the teleport, to organize delivery of cyrium to the Earth.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/7c4273e45ee58bcf2bbe3ec9e53a0f1b10a53fb3.jpg[/img]

[b]The expedition's structure[/b]

[list]
 [*]The space fleet: pilots, officers, ship mechanics, the logistics service, special military squad
 [*]The scientific department, the Search for Life Forms department
 [*]The engineering department (deployment, the teleport)
 [*]The colonists: cyrium miners, food/supporting production employees and base technicians, the requirements department (health professionals, educators, security guards, etc.)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/1385c4bee2c912ed91afad88ebd4a13831be0017.jpg[/img]

Each of the main cruisers can found one base with a network of extraction stations, and also several outposts as required.
The first cruiser carries the teleportation equipment, which is intended to be used for sending the extracted gas to the Earth. Thus, the first base becomes the central one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/1fbb2b6290dfc9ed9eb2f2cea9b2842cd4d9428c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Special military squad[/h1]

The special squad includes 80 military specialists and a separate staff of technicians and health professionals. All the fighters have real combat experience, including the Black and Red operation participants (suppression of a riot at several stations of the Solar System in 2288) and the “Cursed Jinan”.
The squad’s goal is to ensure safety of the expedition. The squad has instructions in case of an emergency situation, ship breakdown, riot, clashes with aggressive fauna, and also very general and nebulous instructions in case of encounter with an alien life form.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/333643630d4259edec75d7a973df0f4e25e1d8b8.jpg[/img]

The manning chart supposes the division of the squad into 10 platoons, which include both stormtroopers and specialists in individual areas. Specialization of individual platoons is envisaged. At the same time, each platoon can perform any tasks in hand due to their vast experience, training, and equipment of the fighters.

For now we’re keeping next week’s topic a secret, but we promise that you won’t be dissappointed :)

In the meantime, you’re always welcome to hang out on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/phUS8ze]Discord[/url] server and chat with the dev team!

notes.title: BLOG #6 Planets of WASP-21
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/ddae609d965ee655a90f543b8497cbdb6188cccd.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! 

This week we’re diving deep into the heart of WASP-21 and will be taking a closer look at the planets where the game takes place. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/41a85f9932b94913ae0f113d3b2b3e7accc00b18.jpg[/img]

Only three planets in the system have an atmosphere. This might be a consequence of terraforming done by the Ancients.

[h1]Wasp-21-b Uno[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/c6100f05c67b687cfdb76fe1a3704c41d5f22d23.jpg[/img]

A terrestrial-type planet with an abundance of oceans (70% of the surface), and also a tropical climate. No cyrium reserves have been found, this creates difficulties as the planet is most convenient for the main base, but the base will have nothing to extract. Rotation lasts 18 hours.
Abundant flora and fauna. Supposed to be the insectoids’ native land. It remains a question how they ended up on another planet. There is a theory of artificial interference. After the contact with them, the SLF department worked on a theory of the Ancients’ civilization using the insectoids for some purposes but more data is required for research.

[h1]Wasp-21-с Bulo[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/c1aae5c5a9227a28020319c00e2ad2f2241441fc.jpg[/img]
 
A planet with a rarefied atmosphere, nevertheless it is easy to colonize. Humans can live on it without specialized costumes, only with a breathing mask. Several cyrium deposits have been explored. Rotation lasts 28.2 hours.

The planet has some life forms, including insectoids.

[h1]Wasp-21-d Erza[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/62194f3b627cbbeff293bf6b87f90ae93c3a6192.jpg[/img]
 
A planet with a large mountainous “continent”, which occupies 60% of the territory. Scanning has demonstrated the presence of large cyrium reserves. The first clash with the Ancients takes place here. Rotation lasts 35.5 hours.

[h1]Uninhabitable objects[/h1]

[b]Wasp-21-a[/b] is a small rocky incandescent planet unfit to live on.

[b]The asteroidal belt:[/b] theoretically there can be cyrium reserves, additional exploration is required.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/ba30e53feda4e4ecf35bb85c923e19d0b55598bd.jpg[/img]

[b]Wasp-21-e[/b] is a small cold planet without an atmosphere. This planet will play a role in the storyline at some point, but we’re not revealing it just yet ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/05059b0394fff7a49880e787f016466bd9604d77.jpg[/img]

Next week we’ll be talking about the expedition to Wasp-21. In the meantime, don’t hesitate to check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/phUS8ze]Discord[/url] server and ask us any questions that you might have, we’re reading every single comment!

notes.title: BLOG #5 THE INSECTOIDS
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/a35fba27a10250d17a89dc8f4edf640afa4c318d.jpg[/img]

Welcome back, explorers of WASP-21!

This week we’re taking a closer look at insectoids, one of the most deadly enemy species in the FARHOME universe. We’ll be looking into the origins and habitat of these creatures and we’re also sharing some concept art. Let’s jump right in!

[h1]FIRST CONTACT[/h1]

The complex and multiform species of insectoids has been discovered on 2 planets of the system (Uno and Bulo). The SLF department supposes that the Wasp-21-b Uno planet is the insectoids’ native land (it is a mistake, this species comes from Allai, the Ancients’ native system).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/c9a58d1b7e82fbc7248b8449b463da36db5c7f22.jpg[/img]

[h1]SPECIES ORIGIN[/h1]

The species had supposedly been artificially modified by the Ancients and used by them in the construction as workers for digging tunnels when extracting cyrium, and also for other tasks.

The question of how the insectoids are controlled by the Ancients has not been answered. But it has been observed that the insectoids have their own instincts, and the Ancients do not have complete control over them, using them only to solve specific tasks, and then leaving the insectoid colony to develop or perish.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/97a3cc322ea9340de7d38e57dd3ae43ac013e4a2.jpg[/img]

[h1]HABITAT[/h1]

Each colony is grown from supplied eggs with the aid of biostations, which provide the necessary conditions for them to mature (temperature, nutritive medium) on any planet where the species can survive. After the first generation matures the colony can provide for its needs on its own.The colony includes several types of insectoids with a definite hierarchy and task sharing. This issue requires additional advanced exploration.

The SLF department has created an insectoid research section consisting of 3 employees.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/e927b19e86851cf22de74e78863209fa87f4cce8.jpg[/img]

The aggressive behavior of the individuals, and also the fact that the Ancients do not control and do not exterminate the colonies after using them (which disturbs the natural environment of the planet where the colonies have been landed), can pose a threat for the expedition and for further colonization.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/cacfd9170486a04434c21b26d34332a831958407.jpg[/img]

The SLF department has introduced the term of “insectoid contamination”.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/6f397b725746bfd9f81b317d820b8f9a5c62b1db.jpg[/img]

And that’s it, see you on the blog next week, where we will be taking an in-depth look at the planets in WASP-21!

notes.title: BLOG #4 THE ANCIENTS
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/23fba8d28024e8e044f5925ac096141cc477d2f8.jpg[/img]

The Ancients’ artifacts first came into the Earthlings' view in 2297 when the second automated mission returned from the Ariadne system with collected samples. Having studied the artifacts, the Association classified all the samples of artificial origin as secret. The researches gave rise to teleport development.

The humans do not know practically anything about the Ancients.
According to the preliminary estimates made at the extraordinary meeting of the expedition, the Ancients' military power is a match for the humans’, but the expedition cannot carry on large-scale armed hostilities due to the enemy’s probable numerical superiority.

However, there is still no data available on the Ancients’ fleet. The first captured samples of battlesuits and dead bodies (after the mission when some artifacts were stolen) demonstrated a high life expectancy of the bodies and a long service life of the equipment: up to three hundred years. This is where the name of  [b] “The Ancients” [/b] spread from, first at the SLF department, and then among the entire expedition.
 
[h1]THE HISTORY[/h1]

This is a biologic humanoid race that has undergone total cybernetization. In spite of the physiological differences, their society used to be similar to the humans’ one, with the same milestones in the history.

Self-appellation: [b]Gishakheli[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/fcb3684959f938883f849bee18418723edf702d0.jpg[/img]

In the distant past, the Ancients encountered problems that were similar to those of the Earth, and solved them in a similar way. The bifurcation point became the creation of the Artificial Intelligence. The Gishakheli had more success in this area, creating the Absolute Cybernetic Intelligence. Soon after that, the race underwent total cybernetization to solve the issues of procurement and resource allocation. The Gishakheli’s bodies and minds became subordinated to a common schedule, which allowed for solving the economical problems.

Several hundreds of years have already passed since then: the progress for the Gishakheli has stopped. A single, though complex, cycle keeps repeating inside the Absolute Intelligence. The Ancients’ expeditions discover resources and extract them in different systems, sustaining the existence of their species. They cannot understand that they go round in circles, and the Absolute Intelligence, despite the seeming freedom and “creative element”, has turned out to be deprived of full life and of the real creative power.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/9056bd574fa5975fa31285e1cd55f043f57ecec7.jpg[/img]

The Gishakheli’s settlements are located in the central system of Allai, which is not known to the humans. During the Intelligence Era, the settlements were reduced to the function of creating new “extraction cells” (ships-processing plants). A few abandoned temples on the Ancients’ two historical planets remind of the bygone era.
 
[h1]IN THE ARIADNE SYSTEM[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/4854da975bb716cacffb5c7c23a4937951aa4ab1.jpg[/img]

The Gishakheli have explored a significant quantity of resources in the galaxy and discovered several types of them that are not known to the humans, and also methods for energy extraction or production. In the Ariadne system there is a “standard extraction cell” consisting of five extraction ships, each of which is a flying plant, a complete automated complex for extraction and processing of several resource types. With the aid of a large teleport, the Ancients transfer energy capsules (a sort of “energy preserves”) to a network node, and from there they are distributed over the Gishakheli’s entire network to provide for the settlements’ equal needs.

notes.title: BLOG #3
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

We apologize for the silence. There was a little force majeure, but fortunately all is sorted out now. For reasons beyond our control, there had been a power outage at the office we rented.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/d6e72a688a1a9112c69eb5bf6aa7c1e59fe3c3fd.jpg[/img]

We hastily relocated to a new office. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/6d6440ece0ff29c9d4b90bc3402ccfc2facbaf07.jpg[/img]

It is quite an adventure – starting from such simple things as kitchen and toilet, and ending with servers, Internet access and building communications throughout the office.
Not everything is working as it should, but pretty much everything is back on track.

So, what we are preparing in the next update:
[list]
[*]a small correction that will balance different types of movement in the game
[*]system of achievement accruing improved
[*]saving of settings in the Steam Cloud added
[*]a new system of movement in space added for those who do not like smooth movement
[/list]  
We continue working on the script – additional touches have been added to the story. 3 new missions are being prepared; work on maps and game mechanics prototypes has been launched. 

We plan to release large updates quarterly. We will give you more details about what exactly will be included in them later.

In addition, we plan to pay more attention to training new players. To do this, we will make a system of interactive tips in weapons and slightly improve the training level. We want players to use the entire arsenal of weapons and special abilities of the characters.

In about 2-3 weeks, we plan to enter the following platforms – Oculus and Viveport. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: BLOG #2 WEAPONS
notes.notes:
Hello friends!
We've decided to devote this publication to talking about weapons and equipment in the game.As you may have noticed, there are two classes represented in the game at the moment: Engineer and Heavyweight. Each class has its own unique (class-specific) weapons that are not available to the other class, as well as common weapons available to all classes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/3acf13f6ec2034768955239ee3fd1da574fa4557.jpg[/img]

The player can take two weapons to a mission. One of them must necessarily be common. This is done in order to avoid a situation when the player is out of ammo. 

The weapons are placed in slots. They can be roughly divided into the upper and lower ones (behind the back and on the belt). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/34b20934ce2a8141e50df4b25537c48358680f91.jpg[/img]

If you place your hand to this region while playing the game, the weapon icon will appear. If you press Grip at that moment, you will take the weapon into your hands. The weapons can be removed in the same way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/d49e52a3e423a6e5e55e680c6c2c86d2f8255ceb.gif[/img]

The slots in the equipment menu correspond to the slots in the game: you can choose where a particular weapon will be located. For example, we prefer placing lightweight weapons in the upper slot, and heavy weapons in the lower slot.

And now, let’s proceed to talking about armament.
An important detail: the weapon shoots more precisely if you hold it with two hands. 
Of course you can shoot holding the firearm in one hand, and some weapons will hit almost without penalties, an assault rifle for example. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/bb14d78b128a6583dc4e661eb1f7bbbde6d882e5.gif[/img]

But try shooting the Shyr gatling gun, we reckon that the difference will be obvious at once. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/6e4c4f96979258e400dca14cc247da4eb1494461.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Common weapons [/b] [/h1]

Well then, let’s start with the common type weapons.

[b] [u]SG-17 Assault Rifle[/u] [/b]

An assault rifle completed with an underbarrel grenade launcher, a standard weapon in the space fleet.It has unlimited ammunition and an automated reloading system. It’s not quite an ordinary one, as many of you have already noticed. Wait for the reloading mechanism to activate, after which the magazine will start being filled with cartridges. Don’t shoot until the magazine has been filled completely, or you will have to wait for the reloading mechanism to activate again.

We’ve decided to implement such a system in order to exclude infinite shooting without penalties. 

The rifle has an underbarrel grenade launcher, which can be shot using your other hand. You will have to take each grenade from the belt and load it into the barrel.

There are several types of underbarrel grenades: 
[list]
[*]frag grenade
[*]explosive
[*]chemical  
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/65414f932362359b371e1215ad0a9606f6f11dbf.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/8e19cea336eec5097cb029a708e63b4d36b917ae.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/ae6a8ab5e6f6f50b225451cbfa46496b5e2e8327.gif[/img]

By the way, you can see the grenade trajectory before the shot to aim more precisely: try pressing the trigger less than fully.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/6ee5ec4985be865c08fc84c607d9805cde08a295.gif[/img]

Don’t forget to take additional grenades along before the mission’s start. 
If you haven’t taken them, you will see the following warning. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/84fc528d5123e3373d97924d2fcd1b8a7141eb5e.jpg[/img]

[b][u]FEG 20H Shotgun[/u] [/b]
A multifunctional shotgun, a weapon designed for special operation forces.

There are three types of shots: 
[list]
[*]conventional (like shotgun pellets)
[*]incendiary
[*]explosive
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/5dae2acc4e327447ec3ad8400c8080747e023c6c.gif[/img]

each of which can be shot with dispersion or as a one-piece bunch

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/e30ea1aa0d62c88c9d3919b7b8b359c9e1e6202c.gif[/img]

you can accumulate up to 6 shots for volley firing

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/832e5f6428182ac67c92b7f3731185b6444f3ece.gif[/img]

[h1] [b] Class-specific weapons  [/b][/h1]

Now, let’s consider the class-specific weapons. Unlike the common ones, you can run out of ammunition with these, so don’t forget to take additional ammunition load before the mission.

[b][u] Shyr Gatling Gun [/u][/b]

A rapid-fire six-barreled machine gun, which runs hot in the process of shooting. With belt feeding.

The customary mode should not provoke any questions, the main thing is to watch for the barrel not to overheat 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/61a17a3c2b3d91493d92d4b9b41af52924cc1547.gif[/img]

By the way, you can cool down the barrels quicker by simply rotating them. Try pressing the trigger half-way. 

Now, we’ll tell you more about an alternative shot. While you are shooting in the main mode, you can see how energy is accumulated. After the charges have been accumulated you can press the second trigger, there will be a burst of energy in the sector in front of the player. If you press it half-way, you’ll be able to see the boundaries of the zone where the damage will be inflicted. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/3adb4ffb2902b3ab4b06964d272fae69b5e89f69.gif[/img]

[b][u]Crawin Beam Gun[/u][/b]

A reassembled smelting unit, it was first used as a combat weapon during the Black and Red Uprising. It shoots an incandescent beam of particles.

Here, everything is quite simple. The alternative mode is more powerful and of longer duration. But the charge consumption is higher as well. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/8b463914db4811fe230e77a16dd2cd269d4c5b6f.gif[/img]

[b][u]CL-02 Coil gun[/u][/b]

A combat energy complex. The tests revealed that it could be used both for shooting and for close-in fighting in case of maximum accumulation of the charge.
It shoots plasma bunches. In the alternative mode, it allows for accumulating the charge. 
It is slower but can inflict damage in a greater radius of action and during flights as well.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/92b5739b2af2bf84d6c9cb1d33882d6f91736a61.gif[/img]

Having accumulated the charge until a ball like this appears at the end of the barrel, you can inflict damage to enemies in close-in combat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/ce54b12317cafe9205e4408b0c38ac37915ec295.gif[/img]

[b][u]Impulse Gun [/u][/b]

It was invented by the expedition’s scientific department. An experimental installation shooting energy charges. Based on activation of cyrium, a high-potential energy source, one of the expedition’s goals.
The alternative mode will inflict more damage and draw the enemies to the explosion epicenter.
If the charge is hit by another charge, this will result in its premature detonation. Be attentive when the enemies are quite near to you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/8b673b3ea95e3fc1309e9c436a10d5a5459f5036.gif[/img]

Here’s how you can replenish the ammunition load 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/fa4ead89df733d9f352fff217929168c7436b208.gif[/img]

[b][u]Rivet Gun[/u][/b]
A universal assembly tool. It’s your only weapon during the Silicon mission. It can be connected to the bracelet to make the shot more powerful, consuming its energy in the process. 
The charges are unlimited in the conventional mode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/c57d033b9adc26fc13bced4ed1825f2ec4bfd568.gif[/img]

notes.title: BLOG #1 STORY
notes.notes:
Hi, friends!
Only a few days left to Early Access launch and we are excited to hear your thoughts. To make it easier to wait, we would like to introduce you to the game world’s history and a plot.

[h1] THE SITUATION ON THE EARTH [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/b5f3b206b14ed4d5425101354d7115d7851b5bf4.png[/img]

The expedition which the game character takes part in was sent out by the [b] International Scientific Association [/b] (ISA) in 2301. The Association had gained great significance in the United Government after the second resource crisis of the 2260s, and by the beginning of the 24th century the Chairman of the Association had the casting vote in the Council of the Government.

A series of energy crises caused a critical need for new resource types. The ISA suggested using the Artificial Intelligence to distribute and control the existing and extracted resources; but the project was never completed. Malicious tongues say that it was only a smoke screen for the ISA to take over the reins of economic control and distribution.

The narrowing neck of the crisis is forcing more and more people into a lifestyle which is similar to subsistence farming, all the “high” technologies become unavailable for the vast majority of Earthians. The ideals of equal opportunities and comfort for everybody have given way to forced ascetics and austerity.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/2fe6d3dbcce997db3d91e0646f8349cbb227b37b.png[/img]

The ISA has been developing a program for expansion into space since the 2240s. A well-known project of theirs became two extra-long-distance expeditions which were the first to discover [b]cyrium[/b], a gas hydrate that served as a promising energy source. Based on the obtained data, the expedition to WASP-21 was organized.

The United Government controls the main informational flows and is the most influential institution of the Earth, extending its influence over 75% of the planet's population.

[h1] THE TELEPORTATION TECHNOLOGY [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/6ce18410d0de61d3ebf5aa2846d322ddb967a3e4.png[/img]

Teleportation began to develop actively in the 2180s, and in the beginning of the new century the technology was already applied at some high-tech production sites.Transfer of living matter became a problem. It is possible over short distances, but when attempted over long ones the animals did not come out of the teleports, they disappeared.

During a new cycle of the resource crisis that entailed riots in border provinces and cities, the ISA presented a program of Earthians’ resettlement to another planet with the aid of teleportation. For this purpose, an expedition was sent out to the system where cyrium reserves had been discovered; among other things, it had to create the receiving teleport.

Another secret of teleportation is that its development was based on alien technologies found by the first extra-long-distance expedition in that system.

[h1] THE EXPEDITION [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/91fc34f5bac69a8e9114bfaa51b7bf9b3f6d7ab4.png[/img]

The expedition started from the Earth in 2301 and reached its target, the [b]Wasp-21 “Ariadne”[/b] system, in two years.The fleet consists of 3 main expeditionary cruisers (each carrying several transports and 3 combat spacecraft units), 3 corvettes, and the commander’s ship. The expedition is 4,200 strong.

[h1] THE WASP-21 “ARIADNE” STAR AND ITS SYSTEM [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/0295121c1a43e09592312a18cc901d265c7888c2.png[/img]

The Wasp-21 star was discovered in 2037 in the Vela constellation. It belongs to the class of yellow-white stars, and exceeds the Sun’s weight by 1.2 times. Its system includes 5 planets discovered in the 2060s-2080s. In 2289 and 2295 the system was visited by two automated missions sent out by the ISA, which collected information about cyrium. The second expedition had a recoverable module that brought specimens of the Ancients’ technology to the Earth, which is kept secret. It was named Ariadne in 2289, after receiving the data from the first automated mission, when the colonization project first appeared.


That's all for now, but this is only a beginning - mysterious ancient race, Wasp-21 system inhabitants, squad and its equipment description and much more is ahead.

notes.title: FARHOME Release date
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/da1f67179b0a7eb9d79395614fce0a48f5d2341a.jpg[/img]

It's been a long road since we've started the development of such an ambitious project. And finally we're ready to show [b]FARHOME[/b] to you. 

We are extremely proud to announce that [url=store.steampowered.com/app/787550/FARHOME/]FARHOME[/url] will be released in Early Access on April 5 for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive. 

You would be able to play as a members of an elite special purpose squad accompanying a large space mission. The goal of the expedition is to deploy the base, to get the extraction of the most precious cyrium up and running, and also to get ready for launching the Portal that will allow to relocate people to a new place. But the new world holds its own threats and challenges. 

We would like to hear what do you think about FARHOME and answer all your questions regarding the game. 

Prepare yourself for the journey and see you next week!
